tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists the blank products available on Hoplix (t-shirts, hoodies, mugs, bags, phone cases...) with product code, colours, sizes, base cost in EUR for front print and for front and back print, production days.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details of one catalogue product: description, colours, sizes, base costs, production days, printable area, pixels needed for the artwork, weight, and the products that can be added to the same campaign.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Lists the seller's campaigns (a campaign is a design applied to one or more products), newest first, with id, name, URL, status, dates, and products with selling price and colours.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: Details of one of the seller's campaigns: name, description, URL, status, currency and its products with product-id, price, colours, sizes and preview images. The product-id identifies a campaign product in quotes and orders.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: Lists the seller's orders, newest first, with status, shipping code and tracking URL. With test=true it lists only the test orders.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Full details of one order: date, your reference, status, shipping cost, tracking and the ordered products. Accepts real order ids and test order ids (TEST-...).

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Status, shipping code and tracking URL of an order, looked up by Hoplix order id or by the seller's own order reference (one of the two is required).

tools.name: check_shipping_address
tools.description: Checks whether a delivery address is complete and the destination country is served by Hoplix. Returns valid true/false with the reason.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Calculates total and shipping cost of an order with the seller's prices and discounts, running the same checks as a real order (campaign products, sizes, colours, quantities, address). Nothing is saved and nothing is charged.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Creates a new campaign: the seller's design printed on a catalogue product (plus optional additional products), with selling price and colours. The design is an image uploaded on a personal Hoplix upload page (front_design_upload_id / back_design_upload_id) or a public http(s) URL of a PNG or JPG im

tools.name: request_design_upload
tools.description: Creates a personal Hoplix upload page for a campaign design and returns its upload_url and a design_upload_id (UPL-...). On that page the user uploads a PNG or JPG image (max 15 MB) from their device; images shared in a chat are not reachable by the server. The link expires in 30 minutes; uploaded i

tools.name: get_design_upload
tools.description: Status of a design upload: waiting_for_upload, uploaded (with file name, type, width and height in pixels) or expired.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Places a real order that Hoplix prints and ships, with the same checks and prices as an order quote. Nothing is charged: the order is created unpaid and goes into production only after the seller pays it from the Orders page of the Hoplix account (the payment link is also sent by email), unless the

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancels an order that is not in production yet; if it was already paid from the wallet the amount goes back to the wallet. Orders in production or shipped cannot be cancelled. Also cancels TEST-... orders.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_order" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_campaigns, get_campaign, list_orders, get_order_status · Private data: create_campaign, get_design_upload, cancel_order · Public sink: create_campaign, request_design_upload, get_design_upload, create_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_campaigns, get_campaign, list_orders, get_order_status · Private data: create_campaign, get_design_upload, cancel_order · Public sink: create_campaign, request_design_upload, get_design_upload, create_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
